feat(examples): effects-feel demo (rich-shimmer-ufj7) (#287)

* feat(examples): effects-feel — the feel demo for shimmer, pulse, drift, sparkle, fade-in and dissolve-out (rich-shimmer-ufj7)

A demo, not a start on src/: the curves live in examples/effects-feel/curves.ts
on top of Effected and the easing vocabulary, and move to src/ only after
Brandon's sign-off (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i).

A powerline strip of a dozen palette cells and a run of text under each
effect, drawn by App at --fps 0.5–30, at --depth truecolor/256/16/none (as the
host's FORCE_COLOR/NO_COLOR), on a --ground dark/light Catppuccin theme, with
per-effect seconds, ease and swing. f and d replay the fade-in and dissolve;
q and Ctrl-C hand the terminal back. Each loop shows the worst text-on-ground
contrast over a full period, read at the run's depth.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(examples): effects-feel moves a strip's fill wherever it shows (rich-shimmer-ufj7)

High review on #287:
- A move applies to the subject's own colours, by hex, in either slot, so a
  powerline arrow moves with the fill it carries and the terminal ground
  behind a cap never gains one (onColors replaces onSlot).
- Subjects are measured at the width they are drawn, inside the padding, and
  re-measured on resize; at-rest contrast is one identity sample, not 1,920.
- A key outside the table repaints nothing, so mouse reports cost no frame.
- The cell walk is graphemes(), the one Effected keys by; parseEase is the one
  ease gate; an empty or non-decimal number flag is refused.
- Tests wait on what the screen shows instead of wall-clock sleeps.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(examples): effects-feel measures each subject whole, once (rich-shimmer-ufj7)

Medium review on #287: measuring per terminal width blocked the event loop
~0.4 s for every width a resize passed through, and compared a per-width
worst contrast against a startup-width rest. A sweep crosses the element,
not the screen, so span and contrast are the element's at its own width:
measured once at startup, the cache and the resize work gone.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(examples): effects-feel reads contrast off the cells it draws (rich-shimmer-ufj7)

Escalation high review on #287:
- Contrast is read from the segments Effected yields, through the wire's own
  drawnColors, so a slot an effect leaves on its ANSI spec is measured as that
  slot; at --depth 16 the old second downgrade measured another colour.
- A DrawnSubject carries its span, its own colours and its text cells,
  measured once; frames no longer re-render or re-measure a subject.
- Text cells are read with the Nerd Font glyphs, so an ASCII seam is not text.
- Each effect row seeds its cells by its own key; the curves use IDENTITY.
- The strip test pulses each ground in the direction the demo does.

Not taken: the ~0.5 s contrast pass at startup is paid once, before the first
frame. The 16-colour slot snap in Effected itself is rich-effects-fxiy.knj.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
